messages:
kira: Attempting to cut a patch for sample-sdk and the publish pipeline blocked me. regendiff shows a bunch of @deprecated JSDoc tags added to exported functions and changelog-generator bumped the release.
ci-bot: publish job 2140 blocked: regendiff mismatch -> https://ci.redwood.example/2140
omar: wait, @deprecated tags shouldn't be a breaking change. paste diff?
kira: snippet: ```diff
- export function createUser(opts?: CreateOpts): Promise<User>
+ /** @deprecated use createUserV2 for better retry semantics */
+ export function createUser(opts?: CreateOpts): Promise<User>
```
lucy: ah, the new policy to tag legacy middleware as deprecated updated the codegen templates. JSDoc insertion is changing the generated file and our regendiff sees it. changelog-generator treats any file diff touching exported signatures as a candidate for semver bump.
jen: we never intended JSDoc-only changes to escalate semver. changelog-generator is too aggressive. We should ignore pure JSDoc additions/removals when computing API-level changes.
change log-bot: note: changelog-generator marked this as "breaking" because diff contained lines in exported symbol block. See artifact: https://artifacts.redwood/regendiff/2140.txt
omar: short-term workaround: strip JSDoc comments before running regendiff comparison. `node scripts/strip-jsdoc.js` before diff. That will make the regendiff clean.
kira: confirmed locally: `yarn typegen:regen && node scripts/strip-jsdoc.js && git diff` -> empty. but that masks the actual deprecation note we want surfaced somewhere.
lucy: propose two changes: 1) changelog-generator: ignore JSDoc-only edits when deciding semver; 2) typegen: emit deprecation metadata in a separate JSON manifest (e.g., artifacts/deprecations.json) so UI and docs can surface deprecations without changing the source file text.
jen: file an issue and a hotfix PR. I think the manifest approach is nice for Console + SDK docs.
typegen-bot: new PR opened: https://git.redwood/eng/devex/pulls/2381 - hotfix to emit deprecations.json and add a regendiff preprocessor to ignore JSDoc-only diffs.
ci-bot: rerun triggered by PR 2381. regendiff on preview run shows only deprecations.json added -> publish allowed pending review.
kira: thanks, merging after approvals.
omar: follow-up: update publish checklist: "If deprecations are introduced via codegen, verify deprecations.json and confirm semver decision; avoid JSDoc-only diffs causing semver bumps."
lucy: also add a short onboarding note in CONTRIBUTING.md: "When running typegen locally, use `yarn typegen:preview` and inspect deprecations.json to preview deprecation signals instead of scanning source diffs."
jen: long-term: Console should surface deprecations.json in the model/API docs and the SDK publish UI should auto-suggest a semver policy (patch/patch+note vs minor) based on deprecation severity.
kira: great. grateful this was just a tooling policy mismatch and not an actual API removal. thanks team :sparkles:
